# XuTurn

> XuTurn is a free, privacy-first file toolbox for Android & iOS. All processing runs 100% on-device: image editing (crop, perspective, filters, mosaic, transparent background), batch image tools (compress, resize, format conversion, EXIF removal), a full PDF suite (images-to-PDF, PDF-to-images, merge, split, compress, encrypt, page management, watermarks, signing), encrypted file vault (AES-256, PIN + pattern unlock), ZIP tools, and high-speed LAN transfer between phone and PC via browser — no cloud uploads, no account, no tracking, no ads.

## Download

Official download channels, all listed on the home page: Google Play, Huawei AppGallery, APKPure, Appteka and GitHub Releases. iOS App Store version coming soon.

## Web Console

When phone and PC are on the same Wi-Fi, the app serves a built-in web console (scan QR to connect, no client install): browse and batch-download files, zip entire folders, and run the same image/PDF tools from the PC browser. The phone provides the computing power; the browser is the interface.

## Privacy Model

Every feature works offline in airplane mode. Files never leave the device unless the user explicitly sends them over the local network. No analytics SDKs, no accounts, no cloud storage.
